```{python}
#| include: false
import logging
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.dates as mdates
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

CWD = Path.cwd().resolve()
PROJECT_ROOT = CWD if (CWD / "config.py").exists() else CWD.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

from config import (
    LOG_FILE_PATH,
    SURVEY_RESPONSE_CSV_PATH,
    ACCOUNTS_PER_DAY_CSV_PATH,
    REPORTS_PER_USER_CSV_PATH,
)

LOG_FILE_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] [%(name)s] %(message)s",
    handlers=[logging.FileHandler(LOG_FILE_PATH, mode="a", encoding="utf-8")],
    force=True,
)
logger = logging.getLogger("dashboard")

FIG_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "output" / "figures"
FIG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

plt.rcParams.update({
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.grid": True,
    "grid.alpha": 0.3,
})
FIGSIZE = (7, 3.5)
FIG_DPI = 200
MARKERSIZE = 3

survey = pd.read_csv(SURVEY_RESPONSE_CSV_PATH)
accounts = pd.read_csv(ACCOUNTS_PER_DAY_CSV_PATH)
reports = pd.read_csv(REPORTS_PER_USER_CSV_PATH)


def start(plot_id, df_name, df, columns):
    """Log the plot attempt and check that the required columns are present."""
    logger.info("[%s] Plot attempted", plot_id)
    missing = []

    for c in columns:
        if c not in df.columns:
            missing.append(c)
    if missing:
        logger.error("[%s] Missing column(s) %s in '%s'", plot_id, missing, df_name)
        raise KeyError(f"{plot_id}: column(s) {missing} not found in '{df_name}'")
    logger.info("[%s] Data present in '%s' with column(s) %s (%d rows)",
                plot_id, df_name, columns, len(df))


def to_day(series, utc=False):
    """Parse timestamps and reduce them to midnight of their day."""
    return pd.to_datetime(series, errors="coerce", utc=utc).dt.tz_localize(None).dt.normalize()


def fill_days(series, ffill=False):
    """Reindex a date-indexed series to every day from its first date until today."""
    days = pd.date_range(series.index.min(),
                         max(series.index.max(), pd.Timestamp.now().normalize()),
                         freq="D")
    series = series.reindex(days)
    return series.ffill().fillna(0) if ffill else series.fillna(0)


def finish(fig, plot_id, date_axis=None):
    """Format the date axis (optional), save the figure as PNG, show it, log the export."""
    if date_axis is not None:
        date_axis.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%d/%m"))
        date_axis.set_xlabel("Date (DD/MM)")
    fig.tight_layout()
    path = FIG_DIR / f"{plot_id}.png"
    fig.savefig(path, dpi=FIG_DPI)
    plt.show()
    logger.info("[%s] Exported successfully to %s", plot_id, path)


def cost_plot(plot_id, column, ylabel):
    """Cumulative cost line chart (used for total and LLM cost)."""
    start(plot_id, "survey_responses", survey, ["submitted_at", column])
    df = survey.assign(day=to_day(survey["submitted_at"], utc=True)).dropna(subset=["day"])
    df[column] = pd.to_numeric(df[column], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    cum = fill_days(df.groupby("day")[column].sum()).cumsum()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=FIGSIZE)
    ax.plot(cum.index, cum.values, marker="o", markersize=MARKERSIZE)
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter("${x:,.2f}")
    finish(fig, plot_id, ax)
```

## Daily Submissions

```{python}
plot_id = "plot_1_daily_submissions"
start(plot_id, "survey_responses", survey, ["submitted_at"])

days = to_day(survey["submitted_at"], utc=True).dropna()
daily = fill_days(days.value_counts().sort_index())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=FIGSIZE)
ax.bar(daily.index, daily.values)
ax.set_ylabel("Number of Submissions")
finish(fig, plot_id, ax)
```

## Daily New Accounts

```{python}
plot_id = "plot_2_daily_new_accounts"
start(plot_id, "accounts_per_day", accounts, ["date", "new_accounts"])

df = accounts.assign(day=to_day(accounts["date"])).dropna(subset=["day"])
new_accounts = fill_days(df.set_index("day")["new_accounts"])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=FIGSIZE)
ax.bar(new_accounts.index, new_accounts.values)
ax.set_ylabel("Number of New Accounts")
finish(fig, plot_id, ax)
```

## Cumulative Accounts

```{python}
plot_id = "plot_3_cumulative_accounts"
start(plot_id, "accounts_per_day", accounts, ["date", "cumulative_accounts"])

df = accounts.assign(day=to_day(accounts["date"])).dropna(subset=["day"]).sort_values("day")
cum_accounts = fill_days(df.set_index("day")["cumulative_accounts"], ffill=True)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=FIGSIZE)
ax.plot(cum_accounts.index, cum_accounts.values, marker="o", markersize=MARKERSIZE)
ax.set_ylabel("Cumulative Accounts")
finish(fig, plot_id, ax)
```

## Research Field Distribution

```{python}
plot_id = "plot_4_research_field"
start(plot_id, "survey_responses", survey, ["research_field"])

counts = survey["research_field"].dropna().value_counts().sort_values()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, max(2.5, 0.4 * len(counts))))
counts.plot.barh(ax=ax)
ax.set_xlabel("Number of Responses")
ax.set_ylabel("")
finish(fig, plot_id)
```

## Domain Distribution

```{python}
plot_id = "plot_5_domain_distribution"
start(plot_id, "survey_responses", survey, ["survey_comparison_type"])

counts = (survey["survey_comparison_type"].dropna().astype(str)
          .str.replace("_", " ").str.title()
          .value_counts().sort_values())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, max(2.5, 0.4 * len(counts))))
counts.plot.barh(ax=ax)
ax.set_xlabel("Number of Responses")
ax.set_ylabel("")
finish(fig, plot_id)
```

## Reports per User Distribution

```{python}
plot_id = "plot_8_reports_per_user"
start(plot_id, "reports_per_user", reports, ["owner_id", "total_reports"])

labels = ["0–9", "10–19", "20+"]
total = pd.to_numeric(reports["total_reports"], errors="coerce").dropna()
bins = pd.cut(total, bins=[-1, 9, 19, float("inf")], labels=labels)
counts = bins.value_counts().reindex(labels, fill_value=0)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=FIGSIZE)
ax.bar(labels, counts.values)
ax.set_xlabel("Reports per User Range")
ax.set_ylabel("Number of Accounts")
finish(fig, plot_id)
```
